breaking.change: Asks for the adapter once. It no longer asks a second time after a null, which covered Chrome answering null while its GPU process starts (a request in the first moments after launch on a headless test host). The engine's own boot asks only where it needs the device, after the wasm and the first world.
breaking.fix: Call webGpuMissing where the page needs the answer (before starting the engine, say), not as the page loads; read a null as no adapter.
